issue_context.title: changefeedccl: only checkpoint spans a certain threshold ahead of highwater
issue_context.body:
Instead of checkpointing every span that is ahead of the highwater, we should consider checkpointing only the spans that are some threshold (maybe a new cluster setting?) ahead of the highwater. That way even with a single checkpoint timestamp, we can reduce a lot more duplicates overall. The current checkpoint timestamp is essentially just a second highwater, which may not provide much value. It will also help us reduce the size of the checkpoint while maximizing its usefulness.

Jira issue: CRDB-45776
comments: Related to this idea above - we might also want to sort the frontier and prioritize the ones that are most ahead of the highwater. Filed https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/137859.
We've decided to not do this anymore given it will be made obsolete by the new improved span-level checkpoint project.
